title: sidebar.toml
description: How the sidebar arranges Threads: every key is optional.

group.description:
How the list is grouped: one list, or each Project under its
header.

inbox.description: What the Inbox shows, and in what order.

projects.description: The Projects in the list. `[spaces]` before ADR 0069 (grace).

bar.description: The counts in the bar's middle: who waits for you, who works.

machines.description:
How machines are named, with another machine in hosts.toml
(ADR 0095).

GroupBy.description:
How the list is grouped (ADR 0098, decision 7, as amended): one list,
the Inbox, or by Project.

oneOf.description: One list.
Each Project under its header.

order.description: Your turn's order: the oldest call first, or the newest.

open.description: Open in the Inbox: Threads seen, with no turn running.

working.description: The Working shelf in the Inbox, under Open.

InboxOrder.description: Your turn's order in the Inbox (ADR 0098, decision 3).

oneOf.description: The one that waited longest first: no one waits forever.
The latest call first.

by.description: What comes first in a section.

oneOf.description: What needs the Person first, then the latest change.
The latest change first.
By title, A to Z.

rollup.description: A Project shows its loudest mark and how many need you.

oneOf.description: The Project with the latest change first.
By name, A to Z.

counts.description: What is counted, in this order; a count of none is left out.

color.description: A question in the attention colour, a failure in red, done in green.

empty.description: What shows with nothing to count.

BarShow.description: When the bar's middle shows the sidebar's counts.

oneOf.description: While the sidebar is closed: it shows the same.
Always, the sidebar open or not.
Never.

Count.description: What the bar's middle counts, each with its mark.

oneOf.description: Threads that ask the Person, or failed: they need an answer.
Threads that finished and the Person has not seen.
Both of those: every Thread that waits for the Person.
Threads at work.

BarEmpty.description: What the bar's middle shows with nothing to count.

oneOf.description: Nothing.
The calm square: the counts stay in their place.

presets.description:
The times the Later's picker offers, in its field's words, up to
eight: "1h", "18:00", "tomorrow 9:00", "mon 9:00".

rows.description:
How another machine shows on its rows: its icon and name, its icon
alone, or not at all.

this-too.description:
Name this machine too, as the others are: a label over its
Projects, its rows where no label names it, its Panes' headers.
Only with another machine in hosts.toml.

MachineRows.description: How another machine shows on its rows (ADR 0095, decision 5).

oneOf.description: Its icon and its name, after the Project.
Its icon alone.
Not at all: its label and its Panes' headers still name it.
